variation: Seated selectorized hip abduction, pads outside knees, back supported, opening legs against resistance then controlled return.
camera: Fixed front three-quarter view showing both outside knee pads and the full seated athlete; enclosed resistance tower behind the seat.
equipment: Real seated hip-abduction machine with backrest, fixed hand grips and two pivoting foot/pad assemblies; resistance routing enclosed, no invented visible cable travel.
primary: Gluteus medius and visible lateral glutes

beats.label: Set and brace
beats.cue: Keep back supported; grip both handles.
beats.pose: Knees near neutral hip width, outside thighs touching outer pads, feet on moving rests.

beats.label: Open your hips
beats.cue: Push both knees outward against the pads.
beats.pose: Halfway abduction; pads and foot rests pivot with legs.

beats.label: Reach your comfortable range
beats.cue: Open comfortably without lifting your hips.
beats.pose: Comfortable full abduction, knees wider, pelvis stable.

beats.label: Control the wide position
beats.cue: Squeeze outer glutes; keep your back supported.

beats.label: Return slowly
beats.cue: Bring knees inward slowly against resistance.

beats.label: Keep tension
beats.cue: Return to start without releasing the tension.
